title: マチカネフクキタル登場！

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: (Today, the stars have aligned. It's my super lucky day. At least…)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: (That's what the gods are telling me, anyway!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Come take a look at this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My goodness! That tea stalk is standing straight up! It was bold enough to break out of the teabag and stick right out!
choice_data_list: Well would you look at that…
Well would you look at that…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Pretty auspicious, don't you think?! This feels like a premonition. Perhaps my day of destiny has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We can't sit around doing nothing. We must leave right away to seek divine guidance at you-know-where!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru, fortune aficionado, starts running toward "you-know-where" as fast as she can.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: O gods, please tell me. Is today the fated day?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Give me a sign! Jagalo, fragalo… Hoooh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I-I got it! Great fortune! That means… my time has finally come, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The gods have imparted to me this message. "Today is the day to set our sights on the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Finally, it's time to get to work! With the moon positioned in the east and the sun positioned in the west, I'm positioned to make my debut!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This is my chance to repay Shiraoki for all my blessings!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The great Shiraoki is the god who always appears in my dreams! One that I'm ever so thankful for!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Take that unforgettable night a few years ago. I couldn't decide whether or not to enroll at Tracen Academy. Why, you ask?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Because I felt utterly useless compared to my perfect big sister. But then, that fateful night…

text_block_list.name: Shiraoki
text_block_list.text: Run, Matikanefukukitaru. Run, and a new path will open.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That revelation is what ultimately brought me to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I couldn't bring myself to run at all until the great Shiraoki gave me the courage to.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! I know I'm not as talented as my sister…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But nobody is as dedicated to the whims of good luck as I am! In fact, good luck's all I have! Luck and nothing but luck will get me to sweet, sweet victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Everyone wishes they could win at some point, right? So I might as well try conquering the Twinkle Series on pure luck, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yay! I knew you'd get me, Trainer! Your skills as an empath make you a true understander!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's not waste such a beautiful day. Shall we ring the bell and offer up our prayers once more?
choice_data_list: I pray that Matikanefukukitaru achieves great success.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! My turn. Please, oh please! Gods, Buddha, and the great Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Please bring me happiness! I'll wait here patiently for it, so whenever you're ready!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems adamant about leaving everything to the supernatural… Nonetheless, Matikanefukukitaru's Twinkle Series challenge begins now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: First off is my debut. Pick a great race for me, please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, I nearly forgot. Try and make sure it's on the most auspicious day of the year, or the prime day for harvest. Only a super lucky day will do!
